neighbours.label: the first surname token right after the first name 'Eric' or 'Rick' in a list of credited people (Eric Ros|coe, Eric F|oner, Rick B|erman); the top examples also include commas in legal boilerplate lists and hash strings, so this is one cluster only
fire: The album's guests include Eric Burdon on vocals and Eric Johnson on lead guitar.
Speakers this year are Eric Hobsbawm, Eric Kandel and several younger historians.
The script was polished by Rick Moranis and Harold Ramis before filming.
On stage that night were Levon Helm, Eric Andersen and Rick Danko.
The panel was chaired by Eric Schmidt and moderated by Eric Topol.
Producers on the record were Rick Rubin and Eric Valentine, with strings arranged later.
The anthology collects essays by Eric Auerbach, Eric Bentley and others.
The pilot episode credits Rick Wakeman and Eric Idle as musical guests.
quiet: The album's guests include Paul Burdon on vocals and Steve Johnson on lead guitar.
Speakers this year are Tony Hobsbawm, Daniel Kandel and several younger historians.
The script was polished by Harold Ramis and Dan Aykroyd before filming.
On stage that night were Levon Helm, Garth Hudson and Robbie Robertson.
The panel was chaired by Susan Schmidt and moderated by Peter Topol.
Producers on the record were George Martin and Brian Eno, with strings arranged later.
The anthology collects essays by Lionel Trilling, Susan Sontag and others.
The pilot episode credits Neil Innes and Terry Jones as musical guests.

notes: Card: no single token. 5 of the top 12 examples peak on the token after 'Eric', 1 after 'Rick'. Probes: 'featured Eric Clapton … and Eric Roscoe' 0.78, 'reviewed by Eric Foner and Eric Sevareid' 0.64, 'written by Rick Berman and Brannon Braga' 0.74, same frame with David/John 0.02; but a lone 'The award went to Eric Holder' gave 0.04, so the name alone is not enough and a list of credits seems to matter. 'electronic, mechanical' legal list 0.76 and "The Rake's Progress" 0.86 are outside this label.
